title: 📊 Mermaid Diagrams in Business Central: Dynamic Visual Intelligence 🎨
summary: Describes a sample Business Central extension that renders Mermaid.js diagrams from live BC table data. It uses three layers: AL page extensions and codeunits, a JavaScript control add-in bridge, and the Mermaid.js CDN. Examples include a Gantt project timeline from job tasks, customer sales flows, BOM structures and order status flows, with selectable themes and scaling and one-click SVG export.
key_points: Mermaid.js is a JavaScript library that generates diagrams from text definitions, similar to Markdown syntax
The framework uses a three-layer architecture: AL page extensions and codeunits, a JavaScript control add-in bridge, and the external Mermaid.js CDN library
Supports multiple diagram types including flowcharts, Gantt charts, ER diagrams, class diagrams, state diagrams, and sequence diagrams
Diagrams are fully customizable with four built-in themes (Default, Dark, Forest, Neutral) and three scaling options (60%, 80%, 100%)
All diagrams can be exported as SVG with one click for use in presentations, documentation, and email sharing
